# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our
community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body
size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender
identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status,
nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and
orientation.

## Our Standards

Examples of behaviour that contributes to a positive environment include showing
empathy, being respectful of differing opinions, and gracefully accepting
constructive feedback. Unacceptable behaviour includes harassment, trolling,
insulting comments, and publishing others' private information.

## One standard specific to this project

Gimbal is built for people recovering from concussion. Do not post a personal
health record, a session export, a report page, or a photograph of one in an
issue, a pull request, or a discussion — yours or anyone else's. The
application deliberately has no upload path, and this repository should not
become one by accident. If a bug can only be explained with real session data,
say so and the maintainer will arrange a private channel.

Do not describe an interface change as an accessibility improvement without
saying which constraint it serves. This population has photophobia,
motion-provoked dizziness, headache, and cognitive fatigue, and "cleaner" has
repeatedly meant "smaller type and less contrast". The constraints are written
down in `README.md` and the design tokens enforce several of them.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behaviour may be
reported to the maintainer at **edy.cu@live.com**. All complaints will be
reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly, and the reporter's identity will
be kept confidential.

_Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), version 2.1._
